verdict.rationale: An on-device ML inference runtime is a fair capability to ask of a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes one. The 'Models' mention refers to game assets like textures and sounds, and native C++/C# support is at most a developer building block, not an official inference runtime.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
